summary: Frontend-only investor regression on public URL completed across desktop (1920x800), tablet (768x1024), mobile (390x844), and reduced-motion modes. Core storytelling sections render, Act II reaches SIMPLE→FRAGMENTING→GOVERNED, nine-step product scene sequencing works with synchronized dialog/checkpoint after deliberate waits, Act V views are functional, and waitlist/booking CTAs are present. Two critical issues found: enterprise channel tabs are blocked by header pointer interception in normal user clicks, and guided-run + rapid scene interaction emits React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Normal click on channel tabs (e.g., Legal) is blocked; header intercepts pointer events so scenario does not switch.

integration_issues.flow: Guided enterprise run + rapid scene controls
integration_issues.issue: Console emits 'Maximum update depth exceeded' during active guided run with repeated scene interactions, indicating a state update loop risk.

issues: Fixed site header overlaps interactive channel row region inside laptop demo, reducing direct click usability.

action_items: Fix click interception for enterprise channel tabs under fixed header so user pointer clicks can change scenarios reliably.
Investigate and remove the guided-run/scene-control state feedback loop causing 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors.
Re-verify Act IV channel-linked context updates (owner/teamspace/cast) after channel click fix.
Add missing data-testid attributes to interactive waitlist legal links (Privacy Policy, Terms).
critical_code_review_comments: Investor page has strong data-testid coverage overall, but two interactive links in WaitlistModal lack data-testid (Privacy Policy and Terms).

Channel switching logic works when triggered via direct DOM click, but pointer-based interaction is blocked by layout stacking (header overlap), pointing to z-index/top-offset hitbox conflict rather than missing handler.
MOCKED/MODELED boundaries are explicit and visible in investor demo/evidence copy; enterprise companies/operators/outcomes remain clearly marked as MOCKED or MODELED.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL /investor only. Confirm channel tabs with normal click (not DOM click fallback) and verify Act IV context changes away from Finance after selecting Legal. Also stress guided-run with repeated rail/tab clicks and monitor console for recurring 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. If fixed, rerun mobile dialog/checkpoint visibility with 1.2-1.6s waits due motion timing.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (channel tabs): In desktop Act III, normal pointer clicks on demo-channel tabs are intercepted by the fixed site header ('site-header intercepts pointer events' observed by Playwright). Because click events do not reach the tab button, scenarioId remains finance and Act IV context does not update. RCA-2 (console error): During guided-run and rapid scene changes, React logs 'Maximum update depth exceeded', suggesting a parent-child state synchronization loop in scene control flow (guided run interval + manual scene updates + synchronized activeScene callbacks).
